title: From a search to a booked appointment
summary: Replay with simulated data, combining a business website and the enquiry tracker. At 9:10 pm someone searching for a physio opens Corner Physio's website on their phone and fills in a two-line booking request, which the site turns into a WhatsApp message they send. The clinic's WhatsApp receives it and the enquiry is logged in its Enquiries sheet as New. In the morning the tracker reminds the clinic of one open enquiry; the clinic offers Tuesday at 6:30 pm, the visitor accepts, and the row changes to Booked.
